result.note: Tested the stated G20 summit venue linked to Canada's deadline for its India trade pact; the deadline itself is only a target, so the venue is the firmer fact.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, Canada set a December target to conclude its trade pact with India. By the G20 summit in which city did Canada aim to wrap up the talks?
questions.explain: Canada aimed to conclude the trade talks by the G20 summit in Miami. The December target was set ahead of a planned visit by Prime Minister Modi.
questions.source: aiming to wrap talks by the G20 summit in Miami.
